text.p: Gerber Scientific Inc said Thursday it purchased 800,000 shares of its common from the estate of its founder, H. Joseph Gerber, for $16.4 million, or $20.50 per share.
The stock was trading at 21-5/8, up 9/16, at mid-day on the New York Stock Exchange.
The purchase was authorized by the board and accomplished in a negotiated transaction, the company said. The stock acquired was about 3.4 percent of Gerber's outstanding stock.
After the sale and charitable bequests, the company said, Gerber's estate continues to own or have options on about 2.3 million of the company's shares, about 10.3 percent of those outstanding.
The executors of the estate have informed the company there are no immediate plans to sell additional shares, it said in a statement.
The company also noted it may purchase up to 763,000 common shares under a pre-existing board authorization.
